capabilities.description: Plugin capabilities with file type specificity

items.description: Capability with optional file type specifier (e.g., 'extract-metadata:pdf', 'generate-thumbnail:*')

capabilities.description: List of capabilities with optional file type specificity. Format: 'operation:filetype' or 'operation:*' for all file types. More specific capabilities take precedence. Operations use hyphenated format (e.g., 'extract-metadata', 'generate-thumbnail').
